verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official hosted MCP server with OAuth whose error-investigation tools let an agent search and filter errors and view occurrences and stack traces. A Faults API also returns fault lists. Separately, Honeybadger can export detailed issues to GitHub, GitLab and Jira and create tickets for selected error events. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent can file tracker issues or take triage actions (resolve/assign) through MCP or the API rather than via configured integrations, explicit ranking of 'top' issues by impact, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
